notes: No production provider switch. Read credentials only from backend/.env.
Same output cap includes Gemini thought tokens, which reduces visible answer allowance. Mistral is non-reasoning.
Raw quality does not treat normalized action_text mismatch as factual falsity. Level B faithfully retains the current stricter backend guard.

retryPolicy: Only explicit HTTP429, bounded exponential backoff; ambiguous 5xx/timeouts stop until reconciliation. All attempts retained.
scope: No paid calls in this command. No production DB connection or provider change.
costNotice: Scenario is a planning assumption (body chars/4 input; Mistral2000 output, Gemini3000 including thoughts), not measured cost. Upper uses UTF8 bytes+4096 input and full6000 output. No free tier/cache discounts assumed.
